payload.text: vc's rulings, 2026-10-28 (by 17:06Z by date -u), on stages 2 and 3 of 0.1.16, made by vc under molt-vc's pen and not by hv; recorded here for hv to review. This reverses the critic's taken recommendation, and the neutral.bats exemption for it is reverted. (2) 0253 Done when 1 accepted as written evidence: the tap showed --version from PATH=/usr/bin:/bin, and help is held by the formula arm, the critic's probe and the same launcher and floor (bin/devbin:65-66, :190, :248; vc read them). (3) 0266 Done when 2 accepted: the scratch formula's name devbin-dc keeps brew_keg_prefix from printing the path, and the arms hold the printed line. (4) 0265 Done when 1 UNTICKED: check's 'empty (expected X)' is a second wording of the empty state; 0265 stays landed, and a low follow-up is filed outside 0.1.16. (5) Stacks built on a tested tip that main carries as other commits land with land-stack's LAND_BASE_OFF_MAIN=1, held by decision 83's files-unmoved check; the chain landed so (0259 1229314e to 0265 7c814e93).
